text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, the final race of the<n>Classic Triple
Crown, is before us.<n>The crowd roars in
anticipation of the<n>drama that will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, meanwhile, merely<n>waits in
silence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Conventional wisdom holds that the<n>Kikuka Sho
goes to the strongest<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A 3,000-meter course with two uphill<n>stretches is
apt to test any racer's<n>mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It demands speed, stamina, and<n>technique in equal
measure. Only an<n>Umamusume who excels in
every<n>area can hope to win the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I were to cede that crown to<n>another, I could
hardly presume to call<n>myself Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But as thanks for your faith in me,<n>allow me to be
your escort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come with me, Trainer... and we shall<n>see the
highest of heights together.
